notes.title: V1.0024
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with audio (hopefully).
Added tracking to the characters. If you right click to select a character rather than the usual left click select, tracking will be enabled, when the character/s move the camera will track with them. If you dont want the camera to track, left select a character and the camera will lock in place and you can move the characters arround without changing screen position.
